title: Schedule of Registration Grace by Length of Service on a Wayfare Driver Agreement
content:
Under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product, an agreement's length of service bears on the registration grace days, the calendar days after a lapsed vehicle registration's expiry date on which the document hold for it begins.

**Tenure rule.** An agreement active at least 1825 calendar days, counted from its activation date to the day the grace is worked out, adds 6 days to the registration grace days; one active at least 730 but fewer than 1825 days adds 3 days; one active fewer than 730 days adds none.

| Days active, from the activation date to the day the grace is worked out | Days added to the registration grace days |
|---|---|
| 1825 or more | 6 |
| 730 to 1824 | 3 |
| fewer than 730 | 0 |

**Notes to the schedule.**
1. The activation date is the one on the agreement.
2. The count is in calendar days and includes no rounding.

**Hypothetical edges (grace worked out on 2026-06-01).** Activated 2021-06-02: 1825 days, adds 6. Activated 2021-06-03: 1824 days, adds 3. Activated 2024-06-01: 730 days, adds 3. Activated 2024-06-02: 729 days, adds none.
